suspicious_patterns: web-search registry entries are not consumed by the autonomous RSS-only job
feed fetch failures are converted to empty results without per-source health state
source topics are descriptive and are not an enforced source-to-tag routing contract
newest-first bounded processing can starve older queue entries under sustained overload
conservative_suggestions: enable verified RSS feeds in small measured waves
add per-source observability before broad expansion
treat scheduled web-search as a separate product and cost decision
measure category coverage rather than registry size
